citedPaper.title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with  Subword Units
citedPaper.abstract: We introduce a simpler and more effective approach, making the NMT model capable of open-vocabulary translation by encoding rare and unknown words as sequences of subword units.
citedPaper.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
